limitations: All CPUs were intentionally saturated for diagnostic coverage; timings are not isolated promotion evidence.
AUTO selected AVX2 on this host; scalar, SSSE3, NEON and other machines were not timed in this sweep.
Only one-loss and maximum-loss patterns and the listed shard sizes were swept.

ratio_semantics: Every ratio is left-hand time divided by right-hand time; above 1 favors the right-hand implementation.

forced_balanced_full_loss_abba.cpu_and_seed: cell index i used CPU i and seed 989855744+i
forced_balanced_full_loss_abba.command_template: taskset -c CPU build/gap-current/bench_leopard2 --k K --r K --bytes BYTES --loss K --batch 1 --reuse 16 --iterations 9 --warmup 2 --threads 1 --seed SEED --profile high --field auto --backend auto FORCE_FLAG --retain-samples --json OUTPUT

ranked_findings.finding: Exact main is faster than the current-tree retained legacy API by median ratios 0.891 encode and 0.926 decode. The dominant broad encode gap predates Leopard2 API dispatch.
ranked_findings.next_action: Causally compare native whole-transform code with portable runtime dispatch, then move coarse complete FFT/IFFT/encode/decode traversals into ISA-specific translation units or otherwise remove per-butterfly callback overhead without raising the archive ISA floor.

ranked_findings.finding: AUTO uses generic only at exact K=R=128, but same-seed ABBA finds generic 13.3% to 41.7% faster than specialized at K=15,16,30,31,32. Generic still trails current legacy by 17% to 27% in these cells.
ranked_findings.next_action: Run the pinned family crossover below, then replace the singleton with the smallest validated deterministic family rule.

ranked_findings.finding: R=1 is an API-path gap, not a portable-kernel gap. At GF8/4KiB current legacy over Leopard2 is 0.821 encode and 0.613 first-use decode; GF16/512B is 0.367 and 0.128.
ranked_findings.next_action: Give direct XOR a lean scratch geometry and linear specialized overlap validation, avoid transform-sized scratch/pointer setup, and measure a reusable prevalidated topology or fused multi-source kernel.

ranked_findings.finding: After removing exact-main/current-legacy effects, Leopard2 encode is still slower at median current-legacy/Leopard2 0.970, especially GF16/512B at 0.920.
ranked_findings.next_action: Fuse range construction with pointer population, add a monotonic-range fast path with safe fallback, and evaluate reusable encode topology metadata.

ranked_findings.finding: At T=128, full-loss GF8 median current-legacy/Leopard2 is 0.751 at 4KiB and 0.827 at 64KiB. Full output removes Algorithm 5 message-only pruning and the materialized specialized path is selected.
ranked_findings.next_action: Use generic for validated full-recovery regions; retain Algorithm 5 for partial output and optimize its high-T materialized/tiled boundary separately.

source_audit.current_policy: Leopard2Dispatch.h:42-61 recognizes only GF8 K=R=T=128, N=256, all originals missing, 256B..1MiB, scalar/SSSE3/AVX2.
source_audit.policy_reason: docs/leopard2_balanced_dispatch.md explicitly says neighboring counts were not measured and therefore remain specialized; the singleton is evidence scope, not a mathematical restriction.
source_audit.execution: leopard2.cpp:1397-1415 applies the predicate only when no forced diagnostic flag overrides it. AUTO plans retain both generic and specialized metadata at leopard2.cpp:636-649.
source_audit.algorithmic_reason: For balanced full loss, Algorithm 5 performs the syndrome-side T IFFT, T FFT, locator-weighted T IFFT, and a nearly full T output FFT after output pruning disappears. The generic active-parent path has lower aggregate work; the existing T=128 model counts 1280 versus 1856 butterflies.
source_audit.scratch_effect: Balanced full-loss specialized geometry already clamps min(N,2T+L) to N; generic also uses N. A crossover change does not increase full-shard scratch in this family.
source_audit.wire_effect: None. Both paths consume the same immutable plan locator and selected coordinates and recover identical requested systematic coordinates.

candidate_dispatch_hypothesis_do_not_mer.predicate: legacy_high_v1 && GF8 && K == R && missing_original_count == K && N == 2*T && T >= 8 && 256 <= rounded_shard_bytes <= 1MiB && backend in {scalar,SSSE3,AVX2}
candidate_dispatch_hypothesis_do_not_mer.rationale: This is the smallest structural family containing the observed gaps while excluding direct-repair T<=4, partial-loss Algorithm 5 wins, GF16 and unmeasured backends.

field_neighbors: GF16 K=129,255,256,257; collect evidence but do not promote through the GF8 rule
required_validation_before_promotion.promotion: >=5% credible target gain, no unexplained >2% neighboring regression
